suppress.notes: CVE-2025-21199 is a false positive. The vulnerability affects the Azure Agent Installer (Windows backup/site recovery agents) due to improper privilege management, not the applicationinsights-core Java SDK. The CPE cpe:2.3:a:microsoft:azure_agent incorrectly matches this library. 3.7.9 is the latest available release and is unaffected.

Apache httpcore 4.4.16 (via feign-httpclient → httpclient 4.5.14). No Apache HttpComponents 4.x patch published for CVE-2026-54399 / CVE-2026-54428 at time of review. Prefer migrating Feign HTTP client off httpclient 4.x when a Boot/Cloud-compatible path exists. Remove when httpcore is upgraded or replaced.
